Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Observed controls/mechanics: Arrow keys move; Z jumps; X attacks; C dashes; A is bind (unused). Short directional inputs of 0.4s work. Close-range Left+Z reliably climbs the mossy ledges; Left+C speeds backtracking. The red-cloaked, white-headed character carries a needle. Health masks remain visible at upper left; no damage, enemies, hazards, item gains, or interaction prompts were observed. Some inputs were rejected for `observation_age_limit` and did not execute.

Observed layout/navigation: The character began on a mossy stone path beside a large ornate organic sphere. Walking right passes the sphere and reaches a mossy wall/foreground rock at the right edge; the sphere itself does not block walking and appears to be scenery. At the right edge the character can become partly or fully hidden behind foreground rock, and the camera stops advancing. Backtracking left follows a long stone/moss path to climbable ledges. Successive leftward jumps ascend several mossy platforms toward a dark upper-left boundary. Walking left at that boundary produced no visible movement. Backtracking right from the upper route and walking off successive ledge edges descends to a lower path; continuing right passes the ornate sphere again and returns to the same right-hand wall. Thus the climbed-left/descended-right route forms an observed loop rather than a confirmed exit.

Failed strategies (observed): At the right wall, repeated walking right, Right+Z, Right+X, and Right+C produced no room transition, visible wall damage, opening, or prompt. At the far upper-left boundary, only ordinary walking left was tested initially and produced no movement. During the later return, a few short Left+Z attempts failed to climb the first ledge until the character walked closer; subsequent close-range jumps succeeded.

Most recent progress: After the right-wall tests, the character dashed left across the loop, reclimbed the left ledges, and used successive Left+Z inputs to reach higher, farther-left mossy terrain. The final Left+Z action was reported completed, but no post-action screenshot was supplied, so the exact resulting position is unconfirmed. The last visible state showed elevated mossy terrain with a dark passage continuing left and no enemies or prompts.

Active goal/hypothesis: Find a passage out of the looping room. The main untested idea is to continue jumping at the elevated upper-left boundary to check for a concealed passage or vertical route above ordinary walking height. This is only a guess; no opening has been seen. Whether the right wall is truly solid, whether anything is breakable, and whether the ornate sphere has any non-walking interaction remain uncertain.
